test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A statement is given followed by two assumption numbered I and II. You have to assume everything in the statement to be true and decide which of the assumptions is/are implicit in the statement.

Statement:

Reading books will make you a morally good person.

Assumptions:

I. Reading books helps one gain knowledge.

II. All successful people read books.

options.text: Both assumptions I and II are implicit
Neither assumption I nor II is implicit

solution:
According to given statement,

Assumption I. Reading books helps one gain knowledge. → This is not implicit because we can not assume about gaining knowledge from books.

Assumption II. All successful people read books. → This is not implicit because we can not assume all successful people read books from the statement. 

**Neither ****assumption I nor II is implicit.**

Hence, the **correct answer** is** "Option 3".**
